description.value: Freshslice Pizza is a BC-founded pizza chain known for its any-toppings model and by-the-slice service, making it a quick and filling stop for hungry cyclists. This New Westminster location on East Columbia Street offers dine-in seating and takeout, sitting on a well-travelled urban corridor near the historic downtown core. It is a reliable option for a hot meal or a few slices to go when passing through the city.
